name: synesis
description: Read links and texts together, discuss them, and record what they meant to you as a growing body of knowledge.

interface.longDescription: Synesis is a personal knowledge system. Give it a link, a note, or an idea. It reads and discusses the material with you, then records not only what you encountered but what it meant to you. A library remembers information. Synesis remembers understanding.
defaultPrompt: Read this link with me and record my take on it
What did we conclude about this topic before?
